story: The Snowy Owl (Bubo scandiacus) is an extraordinary bird that belongs to the Strigidae family. It is most commonly observed in Arctic tundra; meadows; marshes; open grasslands; coastal areas; and agricultural fields, where its behaviors contribute to the ecological dynamics of the area. Listed as Vulnerable (VU) by the IUCN, this species' future depends on continued conservation action. The story of the Snowy Owl is one of adaptation and resilience, offering valuable lessons for conservationists. This poster aims to bring the Snowy Owl into focus, highlighting its beauty and the importance of its habitat.
